int_name: N BROAD ST & W WINGOHOCKING ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban arterial with a marked high-visibility crosswalk. While sidewalks and basic crossing markings are present, the long crossing distance across four lanes of traffic without a refuge island or signalization creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic plus a wide painted buffer area without any mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Signalization
hazards.description: The wide arterial lacks a pedestrian signal or traffic light to provide a protected crossing interval.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a dedicated stop for high-volume or high-speed traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked continental crosswalks and signalized control. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the long crossing distances and lack of physical protection like refuge islands or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Separation
hazards.description: The wide turning radii at the corners allow for higher vehicle turning speeds near pedestrian waiting areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner near the red commercial building

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection with high-visibility crosswalk markings but significant exposure for pedestrians. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric infrastructure, including a gas station and commercial buildings with large curb cuts, which increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection can block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Large Curb Cuts
hazards.description: The gas station entrance creates a wide conflict zone where vehicles may turn across the sidewalk at higher speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a residential and commercial intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk across a two-lane street. While sidewalks and a crosswalk are present, the environment is compromised by poor pavement quality, lack of ADA-compliant curb ramps, and visual obstructions from mature trees and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility devices or strollers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large, low-hanging tree branches partially obscure sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street overhanging the sidewalk and roadway

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface near the crosswalk is cracked and uneven, which can cause tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway and within the crosswalk area

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim low-hanging tree branches to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers at the intersection.
